record.question:
A local thug (bad element) has started illegal construction on your vacant plot. He has refused your
       request to vacate and threatened you of dire consequences in case you do not sell the property at a
       cheap price to him. You would:
options: sell the property at a cheap price to him.
go to the police for necessary action.
ask for help from your neighbours.
negotiate with the goon to get a higher price.
